title: Cartesian pushout products of Kan cells
statement: Use the simplicial sets, monomorphisms, boundaries, horns and weak homotopy equivalences of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $i:K\hookrightarrow L$ be a boundary inclusion $\partial\Delta^m\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$ ($m\geq0$) or a horn inclusion $\Lambda^m_k\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$ ($m\geq1$), and let $j:P\hookrightarrow Q$ be a monomorphism of small simplicial sets. The Cartesian pushout product $i\mathbin\square j:(Q\times K)\amalg_{P\times K}(P\times L)\to Q\times L$ is a monomorphism. It is a weak homotopy equivalence if $i$ is a horn inclusion or if $j$ is a weak homotopy equivalence.
